messages.text:
I’m about to make the actual files: a Python `eza_py.py`, a direct `executable` launcher, a Windows `.cmd` launcher, and a `compile.sh` that marks the launcher runnable.

The implementation will avoid the reference binary entirely and reproduce the listing/rendering behavior itself.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $out=& $ref probe_dir -l --color never --icons never; $out | ForEach-Object { '"'[' + "'$_ + '"'] len=' + "'$_.Length }'
commands.preview: $ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $out=& $ref probe_dir -l --color never --icons never; $out | ForEach-Object { '"'[' + "'$_ + '"'] len=' + "'$_.Length }
